## Reviewer Checklist
- [ ] Behaviour matches `docs/requirements.md` acceptance criteria
- [ ] No secrets in code, logs, fixtures or generated output
- [ ] User input and API responses are validated
- [ ] API failures, missing files and empty repos are handled gracefully
- [ ] Tests cover the happy path and the Not Found / missing-field cases
- [ ] No duplicated logic; names are self-explanatory
- [ ] Dependency audit is clean
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
